intelligence.human_view: He said: so, maybe dismiss — take me — when I said pasting comes out beautiful, that means anything they paste in when they enter NayaNET, like when they first get their pages, it'll come out beautiful, because the pages we've already created them to be beautiful — they're going to come up beautiful. Or like, say, in the Smart Factory, if they add a new page, whatever they input into the system is going to come out beautiful. It's like you're building a whole new factory — if you're going to do what you're doing, build it into the Smart Factory, make it one. Why are you building another system? He doesn't think that's the way to do it, how we're doing it. It should be much more natural and direct: pretty much all the areas — we know what questions need what we're filling in, we know what they're doing in mission, vision, goal, skill — so we're just going to ask them those questions. We'll have an automated survey kind of thing in the Smart Factory, where they'll just walk through and answer the questions, and those questions will produce the pages. That's it. Doesn't that make sense? So he's not sure what we're doing, or the purpose of this. You think they're going to come specifically to this app to get one piece of information outputted beautifully? Just in all those different ways? Well — depends. If you're making this for the intention of, like, anybody can put anything into here and then have this available in NayaNET, so it'll show up in the feed or in their pages — then maybe he would find that purposeful.
